user.title: Add ESL label
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of the label. Advertised addresses start with 66:66.

data_description.scan_interval_min: How often to connect for status and version. Battery level arrives passively from advertisements, so a long interval is fine.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address, expected AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

abort.already_configured: This label is already set up

data_description.linger_s: How long to hold the Bluetooth connection after a command. Reconnecting means waiting for the label to advertise again, which takes minutes, so a short linger makes follow-up commands instant. 0 disconnects immediately.
data_description.battery_full_mv: Voltage of a fresh cell. 3000 mV suits the 3 V lithium coin cell these labels ship with.
data_description.battery_empty_mv: Voltage at which the label stops working. The percentage is interpolated between the two and is an estimate, not a reading.
data_description.model: Sets the default size. Pick the closest one and correct the size below if it does not match.
data_description.width: 0 takes the width from the model. Set it directly for a panel that is not listed.
data_description.height: 0 takes the height from the model.
data_description.pixel_format: bwry is four colours at 2 bits per pixel, mono is black and white at 1 bit.

error.battery_range: The full voltage has to be above the empty voltage.
